title: 第2章 挣钱啊挣钱
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不过就在此刻，陈冷汐的手机忽然响了起来，她看到手机上的电话号码后脸色一变，不过她还是接了电话，纤细的白嫩的手指按了接听键。

“喂！放心吧我一定还的，请给我一点时间好吗，求求你们了。”

陈冷汐将手机拿到了耳朵边，对着电话述说了一通然后挂断了电话，她似乎要哭出来了。

“怎么回事？”

小姑妈放下电话后，看到姑妈的晶莹的眼泪，陈锋则皱了皱眉。他明显感觉到姑妈遇到了麻烦，而且是不小的麻烦，不然小姑妈是不会哭的。

陈锋记得小姑妈一直都很坚强的，他记得小时候有一次小姑妈的手指被蜜蜂给蛰了；还有一次小姑妈去树上摘桃子结果不小心掉下来把腿摔断了，她疼的要死，不过即便那样都没有掉一滴眼泪。

但是现在，姑妈竟然哭了。

“是这样的，冷汐为了给我看病前段时间瞒着利用房子做抵押借了银行很多钱，这傻孩子啊。”

陈沧海则叹气道。

“借了多少？”

陈锋询问。

“借了40多万了。”

面对小侄子的询问，陈冷汐有些不好意思，毕竟当时的她也没办法了，她不能眼睁睁看着父亲死去只能用房子抵押去银行贷款，不过她没想到的钱花了父亲的癌症也没看好，如今还是靠侄子救了父亲。

早知道这样的话，她就不借钱了，因为如果没钱还的话房子可能被银行收走，刚才就是银行经理给她打的催款电话。

“放心吧小姑妈，这点我来还。”

得知情况后陈锋不以为意，嘴边还浮现了一丝笑容，似乎这不是什么大事，而是小事一桩。

“什么？你怎么还？“

“是啊小峰，你哪来的钱？”

陈沧海和小女儿都看向了陈锋，他们的目光里分明充满了疑虑，毕竟陈锋才25岁，他能有什么钱，他怎么挣钱。

“放心吧，钱的事情交给我就行了、”

陈锋也懒得在和家人解释修仙的事情了，他知道解释了家人们也不会相信，这个太玄乎了。

当然有一点是肯定的，就是他要帮小姑妈帮家里人还钱，是绝对不会让家人们没房子住得，这个房子是绝对不能被收走的。

另外他还打算去购买一栋大一点的别墅，以后让爷爷和小姑妈跟着他吃香的喝辣的，过着幸福美满的生活，毕竟他只有这么两个亲人了。

对于挣钱陈锋有一万种方法，要知道如今的他可是筑基后期的修士，他会画符，会炼制丹药，会法术，会布阵，他有诸多本事区搞点钱还不是轻而易举的吗，还不是小菜一碟吗，钱对他而言不过是一串数字而已。

“小峰，你在想什么呢？我们刚才问你怎么挣钱？”

But at this moment, Chen Lengxi's cell phone suddenly rang. Her expression changed when she saw the phone number on the phone, but she still answered the call and pressed the answer button with her slender white fingers.

"Hey! Don't worry, I will definitely pay it back. Please give me some time, please. I beg you."

Chen Lengxi held the phone to her ear, spoke into the phone and then hung up. She seemed about to cry.

"What's going on?"

After the little aunt put down the phone, Chen Feng frowned when he saw her aunt's crystal tears.He clearly felt that his aunt was in trouble, and it was a big trouble, otherwise the little aunt would not cry.

Chen Feng remembered that his little aunt had always been strong. He remembered that one time when he was a child, his finger was stung by a bee; another time when his little aunt went to pick peaches from a tree, she accidentally fell off and broke her leg. She was in terrible pain, but even then she did not shed a single tear.

But now, my aunt is crying.

"It's like this. In order to treat me, Leng tide borrowed a lot of money from the bank without telling me and used his house as a mortgage some time ago. What a stupid boy."

Chen Canghai sighed.

"How much did you borrow?"

Chen Feng asked.

"I borrowed more than 400,000 yuan."

Facing her nephew's inquiry, Chen Lengxi was a little embarrassed. After all, she had nothing to do at the time. She couldn't just watch her father die and had to use her house as mortgage to get a bank loan. However, she didn't expect that the money was spent on her father's cancer, and she still relied on her nephew to save her father.

If she had known this, she would not have borrowed money, because if she had no money to repay, the house might be taken away by the bank. The bank manager just called her for payment.

"Don't worry, little aunt, I will repay this."

After learning about the situation, Chen Feng didn't take it seriously, and a smile appeared on his lips, as if this was not a big deal, but a trivial matter.

"What? How do you pay it back?"

"Yes, Xiaofeng, where did you get the money?"

Chen Canghai and his youngest daughter both looked at Chen Feng. Their eyes were clearly full of doubts. After all, Chen Feng was only 25 years old. What kind of money could he have? How could he make money?

"Don't worry, just leave the money to me."

Chen Feng didn't bother to explain the matter of cultivating immortals to his family. He knew that they wouldn't believe it even if he explained it. This was too mysterious.

Of course, one thing is certain, that is, if he wants to help his aunt pay back the money for his family, he will never let his family have no house to live in. This house must not be taken away.

In addition, he also plans to buy a larger villa, and let his grandfather and aunt follow him to eat well and live a happy life. After all, he only has these two relatives.

Chen Feng has thousands of ways to make money. You must know that he is now a monk in the late stage of foundation establishment. He can draw talismans, refine elixirs, spells, and set up formations. He has many abilities. Isn't it easy to make some money? Isn't it a piece of cake? To him, money is just a series of numbers.

"Xiao Feng, what are you thinking about? We just asked you how to make money?"
